10 استوفض : see 1, in two places. ＝
-A2- Also, He required, or commanded, another to hasten, or be quick, or he hastened, hurried, or urged, him. (S, M, A, K, [but in the M; it seems to relate to camels, or an ostrich.]) ―
-b2- He drove away (S, M, K) camels, or an ostrich; as also ↓ اوفض : (M:) he drove away, or expelled, another from his country: (M:) he banished him. (Mgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
